quests.title: Hilichurl Justice

dialogue.t: Mimi tomo, mimi mosi mita, Muhe mita?
Mita...? Gusha... Dada odomu Plata mimi, mimi mosi gusha...
Mimi tomo, mimi plata odomu! Mimi mani ye!
Mani...? Dada! Kundala zido mi, mi dada, mimi tomo!

dialogue.sit: But I don't understand a word they're saying...

dialogue.t: It was... bullied... by someone very nasty. We need to help it vent its anger. That's all it wants.

dialogue.sit: Assuming no translation is needed for that...

dialogue.t: Okay then, the location is marked on your Map — I'll leave the next part to you!
Du Wei zido dala? Mi mito nye.
Huh, that's strange — this one claims to know nothing about it!
Mi mito du, du ya mito Wei.
And now it's pointing to the Map, saying that someone it knows over here may have seen the Unusual Hilichurl before.

quests.description: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues…
